0:
Sets the wrestler's attack style.
Choose from 3 options: Wrestling,
Hybrid Wrestling, Shoot Wrestling.

　　- Wrestling: the standard style
　　- @YHybrid Wrestling@D: Hybrid grapple
　　strikes available
　　- @RShoot Wrestling@D: mount grapples
　　available
1:
Sets the wrestler's stance in
matches. Choose from 5 options:
Wrestling, Martial Arts, Shoot
Wrestling, Normal, Women.
10:
Sets how easily the wrestler bleeds
during a match. Choose from
3 options: Rarely, Normal, Often.
11:
Sets how easily Spirit rises when
the wrestler bleeds. Choose from
3 options: Rarely, Normal, Often.
12:
Sets how easily the wrestler
recovers from a downed state.
Choose from 3 options: Rarely,
Normal, Often.
13:
Sets how the wrestler climbs the
post. Choose from 2 options:
Normal, Jump.
14:
Sets how far flying moves reach.
Choose from 5 options: Shortest,
Short, Normal, Long, Longest.
15:
Sets how often the wrestler looks
for a weapon outside the ring.
Choose from 4 options: Never,
Rare, Normal, Often.

@Y(Note)@D
　　Setting @BNever@D means the wrestler
　　will never pick up a weapon.
16:
Sets the weapon the wrestler most
easily finds outside the ring.
Choose from 7 options: Random,
Chair, Broken Table, Kendo Stick,
Barbed Wire Bat, Bat, Sickle.

Setting @BRandom@D means picking up
every weapon evenly.
18:
Sets how to attack a standing
opponent early in the match.
Choose from 3 options: Striking,
Grappling, High Flying.
19:
Sets how to attack a standing
opponent late in the match.
Choose from 3 options: Striking,
Grappling, High Flying.
2:
Sets the weight class (body size).
Choose from 3 options: Heavy,
Jr. Heavy, Super Heavy.

@Y(Note)@D
　　A wrestler set to @RSuper Heavy@D is
　　hard to throw with normal throws,
　　and very likely to reverse throws
　　used against him.
20:
Sets how to attack a downed
opponent early in the match.
Choose from 4 options: Striking,
Ground Grappling, High Flying, Up.

@BUp@D literally means waking the
opponent up to a standing position.
After that, the @Gattack vs. standing
opponent@D setting applies.
21:
Sets how to attack a downed
opponent late in the match.
Choose from 4 options: Striking,
Ground Grappling, High Flying, Up.

@BUp@D literally means waking the
opponent up to a standing position.
After that, the @Gattack vs. standing
opponent@D setting applies.
22:
Sets whether to attack mainly with
strikes or grapples. Choose from
5 options: Always Strikes, Mainly
Strikes, Balanced, Mainly Grapples,
Always Grapples.
23:
Sets how well the wrestler reacts
to the opponent's strikes.
Choose from 3 options: Fast,
Normal, Slow.

Setting @BFast@D raises the chance of
avoiding strikes with guards and
catches.
24:
Sets how well the wrestler reacts
to the opponent's grapples.
Choose from 3 options: Fast,
Normal, Slow.

Setting @BFast@D raises the chance of
avoiding grapples with ducking and
grapple parries.
25:
Sets the attack type: offense or
defense. Choose from 5 options:
Always Attacks, Mainly Attacks,
Balanced, Mainly Defends,
Always Defends.
26:
Sets how the wrestler fights
outside the ring. Choose from
5 options: Calm, Normal, Aggressive,
Very Aggressive, Fly.

With @BVery Aggressive@D especially,
the wrestler goes outside on his own
to look for weapons.
27:
Sets how often the wrestler taunts
during a match. Choose from
3 options: Often, Normal, Never.

@Y(Note)@D
　　Setting @BNever@D means the wrestler
　　never taunts during a match.
3:
Sets the wrestler's movement speed.
Choose from 3 options: Slow,
Normal, Fast.
4:
Sets Irish Whip behavior (throwing
to the ropes, etc.). Choose from
2 options: use it and take it, or
neither.
5:
Sets whether to go for a @Ypin@D or
a @Ymount position@D with the @Bducking
button@D against a downed opponent.
Choose Pin or Mount.
6:
Sets skill at submission holds.
Choose from 3 options: Expert,
Normal, Novice.

It changes the damage submissions
deal and how fast the opponent
escapes to the ropes.
7:
Sets how the wrestler ducks under
the ropes. Choose from 6 options:
Normal, Jump, Over the Top,
Leap Frog, Flip Over, Women.
8:
Sets how the wrestler avoids a
running opponent. Choose from
4 options: Jump, Drop, Both, None.

@Y(Note)@D
　　Setting @BNone@D means the wrestler
　　cannot leap frog at all.
9:
Sets how fast health recovers
during a match. Choose from
3 options: Slow, Normal, Fast.
